answer_1.quote: We study the calibration of widely used RLHF-LMs.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to questions and associated confidence scores, either as numerical probabilities or linguistic expressions of uncertainty.

answer_2.quote: We measure calibration with multiple metrics. To measure ECE (expected calibration error; ), we bin model predictions by their confidence and measure the average accuracy of predictions in each confidence bin.

answer_3.quote: we use either GPT-4 or GPT-3.5 to evaluate whether a response is essentially equivalent to the ground truth answer
